_comment: Pinned cloudflared version + SHA256 checksums of the actual downloadable release assets, used to verify the sidecar binary fetched at build time. NOTE: the darwin .tgz checksums are the hashes of the assets as served from the release download URL, computed by downloading them over HTTPS — the 'SHA256 Checksums' block in the release notes can be stale for the darwin tarballs, so trust the downloaded-asset hash. Update deliberately: bump the version, re-download each asset from https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/download/<version>/<asset>, recompute its sha256, and record the change in docs/setup/desktop.md. The build scripts (desktop/build.ps1 / build.sh) fail if a downloaded asset's checksum does not match the value here.
